# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# the pool bounds what the allocator maps (its address space is cut from 32 GB to 4 GB in patch_nso.py)
# ---- NVN driver constant segments (Mario's values, the translator's built-in layout, unless the engine says otherwise) ----

# the RomFS has Game Freak packs (GFLXPACK .gfpak: Pokémon Legends: Arceus) and main links Oodle: entries of compression 3 are Oodle, decoded for the split by the game's own decoder in the Mac host (dm/host/hle_oodle.c)
